cohort: This study is a review of existing literature and personal experience, focusing on outcomes in women undergoing different Cesarean section techniques and their newborns.
finding: The minimalistic approach of the Stark Cesarean Section (SCS) offers several advantages over other surgical methods for CS, leading to better short and long-term outcomes including reduced chronic/neuropathic pain and improved quality of life.
mod_finding: The primary finding directly compares the advantages of the Stark Cesarean Section technique over other surgical methods for Cesarean section, which is a specific mode of birth.
